title: Sabercross v0.1.97. What category or genre would you label this under?
author: strike_radius

comments.author: lesuperhun
comments.body:
back in the flash game era, this would be considered slop.  
not slop in the ai sense of the term, just slop. asset slop, maybe ?  
random assets, random pngs moving around a screen without animations, barely any gameplay, no consistency or real game design.

replies.author: strike_radius
replies.body: Nothing on the screen is random. The pacing is pretty fast. Animations are bare minimum for prototyping. Maybe if you tried playing the game you'd actually have a sense of the actual design and combat mechanics.

replies.author: lesuperhun
replies.body:
there are dinos, prehistoric caves, spacecraft, guns, swords, morcycles, nukes, isometric graphics, non isometric graphics, everything is wildly out of scale.  
a fuel gauge that goes up to 1000%, because it's so much cooler than 100% 😎

those are the hallmarks of old-style edgy slop.

replies.author: strike_radius
replies.body: All of that is relevant to the setting. The focus is solely on prototyping, developing combat mechanics and just adding on to the game engine. Not appealing art or visuals. The fuel gauge goes to 100%, there's just a decimal I haven't removed and the font is not very good.

replies.author: -goldenboi69-
replies.body: Maybe you should try something else?
